connect.caption: Setup tab, Connect a service. Pick the service (here Stripe) and paste its API key. It is encrypted and never shown again.
Give your agent (or your developer) the AgentRaaS URL and key shown here. The key is shown only once.
One key per agent: + Connect agent, pick where it runs (here Make, Zapier or another no-code tool) and name it.
Paste the setup text into your tool. When the agent makes its first call, it shows up here.
Every call is listed under Recent activity. Click a row for its details.

retries.caption: Click Run live dedup test: 8 identical calls go to a sandbox and only 1 runs.
Click a Deduplicated row to see why it was not sent again.

validation.caption: Rules tab, Validation rules. Name the service and action (Stripe, charge.create), then add a field: amount must be a number from 1 to 10000.
Try it before saving: paste a sample and click Test. 50000 is too big, so it would be refused.
Click Save rule. It is listed under Saved rules and applies right away.
When an agent tries to charge 50000, the call is blocked and never reaches Stripe. The row says why.

approvals.caption: Rules tab, Approval rules. Hold Stripe charges when the amount is greater than 5000.
Monitor tab, Waiting for approval: the held call, with exactly what it wants to do.
Approve runs the call once. The first decision wins, here or from Slack, Teams, Telegram, Discord or an email link.
Deny drops it: the charge never happens and the agent is told it was denied.

spend-caps.caption: Rules tab, Spend caps. billing-agent may charge at most 10000 in total per day on Stripe. Max calls caps the number of calls instead.
Click Save rule. Leave Agent ID empty to cap every agent. "Route to approval" holds the call for a person instead of blocking it.
The agent tries to charge 12000 today: over the daily total, so it is blocked before Stripe. The row says which cap stopped it.

policies.caption: Rules tab, Action policies. support-agent may send email (Resend) only to addresses at acme.com.
Click Save policy. "Never allow" blocks an action outright; allowed hours limit when it may run.
The agent tries to email someone@gmail.com: blocked, the email is never sent. The row names the policy.

failures.caption: Monitor tab, Failed requests: every call the service itself refused, with its error (here Stripe: invalid API key).
Fix the cause first (here: paste the right key in Setup, Credentials). Then click Replay, or Edit & Replay to change the payload first.
A replayed call that succeeds leaves the list. Dismiss removes one you do not want to send.

undo.caption: Monitor tab, Undo actions: what each one will run to reverse it (here a refund).
The refund runs once. The entry is marked undone and cannot be undone twice.

record-replay.caption: Monitor tab, Recordings: each recorded run, how many calls it made and when.
Click View to see every call and its answer. A replay is answered from here, so nothing reaches the real service.
